metadata.study: Phase 22 H1 — R3 Architecture Integration Feasibility Study

pipeline_stages.role: Lexical valence and semantic density encoding into 16D stimulus vector.
Generates internal generative forecast p_hat_T = A*p_{T-1} + b.
Integrates stimulus via Coupled MT-LNN ODE producing post-stimulus limbic state p_T.
Computes prediction residual r_T = p_hat_T - p_T and scalar norm S = ||r_T||_2.
Modulates cognitive load and tension from scalar intensity S.
Retrieves subconscious echo vector from affective memory traces.
Queries proposition store for factual retrieval.
Regex and safety validation (strips self-reported affect).
Encodes experience into Kanerva SDM trace.
Queues high-salience experiences for offline BPTT.

rq1_pipeline_placement.earliest_creation_point: ActiveInferenceEngine.step() at Stage S4, where generative forecast p_hat_T and bodily state feedback p_T are combined into prediction residual r_T = p_hat_T - p_T.
rq1_pipeline_placement.transport_mechanism: Encapsulated immutable Value Object (PhysiologicalSurprise) emitted from S4 and held in CognitiveOrchestrator turn execution context.
prohibited_non_consumers: EmotionCore ODE Hidden State h(t) (Pre-Reflective Invariant: prediction error must NOT be injected into limbic ODE integration)
BoundaryLayer (Safety validation must remain orthogonal to limbic prediction error)
Telemetry Watchdog / StabilityEvaluator (Tracks execution timing and scalar stability bounds)
Somatic Load / Energy accounting (Metabolic resources are driven strictly by scalar intensity)

EmotionCore.description: Placing R3 derivation and storage inside EmotionCore.
EmotionCore.single_responsibility: VIOLATION: EmotionCore owns continuous limbic state p(t) and ODE integration, not generative model forecasting or expectation error.
EmotionCore.dependency_direction: POOR: Requires EmotionCore to know about ActiveInference generative model matrices A and b.
EmotionCore.testability: POOR: Testing prediction error would require spinning up full ODE integration loops and locks.
EmotionCore.r2_compatibility: POOR: Couples geometric orientation directly to fast-loop ODE hidden state.

ActiveInferenceEngine.description: Deriving R3 inside ActiveInferenceEngine as part of prediction residual computation.
ActiveInferenceEngine.single_responsibility: ALIGNED: ActiveInferenceEngine owns internal generative model, forecasts p_hat, and residual r_T.
ActiveInferenceEngine.dependency_direction: ALIGNED: Pure unidirectional computation from bodily states (pad_before, pad_after).
ActiveInferenceEngine.testability: HIGH: Step function can be tested in complete isolation with mock PAD vectors.
ActiveInferenceEngine.r2_compatibility: ALIGNED: ActiveInferenceEngine already calculates the exact continuous residual vector delta = predicted - q.

CognitiveOrchestrator.description: Orchestrator computing R3 signs in S4 or storing mutable directional state.
CognitiveOrchestrator.single_responsibility: VIOLATION: Orchestrator is a composition coordinator; implementing limbic math violates separation of concerns.
CognitiveOrchestrator.dependency_direction: POOR: Bloats Orchestrator with mathematical thresholding and sign quantization logic.
CognitiveOrchestrator.testability: POOR: Requires integration harness to test basic mathematical sign derivation.
CognitiveOrchestrator.r2_compatibility: POOR: Orchestrator would need to manage normalization checks and float tolerances.

Dedicated_Value_Object.description: Immutable domain value object (PhysiologicalSurprise) encapsulating magnitude S and directional side-channel R3.
Dedicated_Value_Object.single_responsibility: EXCELLENT: Single Responsibility Principle adhered to bit-exact. Encapsulates measurement data without business logic.
Dedicated_Value_Object.dependency_direction: EXCELLENT: Inversion of Control / Dependency Inversion. Downstream consumers depend on an immutable interface contract.
Dedicated_Value_Object.testability: EXCELLENT: Value object can be instantiated, serialized, and verified in isolated unit tests with zero dependencies.
Dedicated_Value_Object.r2_compatibility: EXCELLENT: Can expose both .direction_signs and future .direction_unit while maintaining identical public interface.
Dedicated_Value_Object.backward_compatibility: EXCELLENT: Exposes .magnitude (float) or supports float() coercion to ensure zero breaking changes for scalar-only consumers.

rq3_interface_shape.docstring: Immutable domain value object representing physiological prediction error: canonical scalar magnitude S and auxiliary directional side-channel.

magnitude.description: Canonical scalar surprise S = ||r_T||_2. Answers 'How large is the prediction error?'.
magnitude.canonical_role: Primary intensity and urgency driver; monotonically drives load, tension, and depth k.

direction.description: Coarse discrete PAD octant/quadrant orientation. Answers 'In which PAD directions did the prediction error occur?'.

timestamp_tick.description: Monotonic exposure or turn index at which prediction error was evaluated.

exposure_ticks.description: Number of ODE exposure ticks (T) integrated during stimulus presentation.

storage_vs_dof.stored_representation: 1 float32 (4 bytes) + 3 int8 symbols (3 bytes) = 7 bytes uncompressed; optimal packed encoding ceil(log2(27)) = 5 bits.
storage_vs_dof.mathematical_degrees_of_freedom: 1 continuous degree of freedom (magnitude S in R_>=0) + 27 discrete sign states in {-1, 0, +1}^3.
storage_vs_dof.distinct_from_3_bits: Ternary symbols have base 3, yielding 3^3 = 27 states. 3 binary bits yield only 2^3 = 8 states, which cannot represent 0-crossings.

invariants: direction.pleasure in (-1, 0, 1) and direction.arousal in (-1, 0, 1) and direction.dominance in (-1, 0, 1)
Frozen / immutable: instances cannot be modified after construction

rq4_scalar_preservation.invariance_statement: S_new = ||r_T||_2 is algebraically and computationally identical to canonical scalar S_canonical. The side-channel R3 = sign(r_T) is a separate auxiliary field and introduces zero mathematical coupling or feedback into S.
forbidden_mutations_checked: No rescaling of S by directional magnitude (S is not divided or multiplied by directional factors)
No alteration of Coupled MT-LNN ODE dynamics (fast-loop ODE hidden state remains completely untouched)
No modification of Active Inference Free Energy gradients dFE/dA or dFE/db
No retroactive alteration of historical surprise values or benchmark archives

CognitiveLoad_Modulation.rationale: Cognitive load represents a scalar metabolic demand on processing capacity. Modulating it by valence sign (+ vs -) violates homeostatic principles; somatic load should be driven strictly by scalar error magnitude S.
CognitiveLoad_Modulation.failure_mode: Unequal metabolic depletion between positive and negative surprises, distorting pacing latency.
CognitiveLoad_Modulation.evidence_support: Phase 22 Behavioral study demonstrated S retains monotonic association with load (r >= 0.888) regardless of direction.

ReasoningDepth_Selection.rationale: Depth switching is already driven monotonically by scalar surprise magnitude (r = 0.865). While Arousal directional error has a slight positive correlation (r = 0.161), scalar S is already sufficient for depth tiering.
ReasoningDepth_Selection.failure_mode: Unnecessary reasoning overhead if triggered on low-magnitude directional noise.
ReasoningDepth_Selection.evidence_support: Modest correlation only (r = 0.1614); discrete signs do not add necessary depth differentiation beyond S.

EFE_Action_Valuation.subsystem: Expected Free Energy epistemic policy selection
EFE_Action_Valuation.rationale: Directly demonstrated in Phase 22 Behavioral Utilization Study: directional sign side-channel differentiates 79.89% (286/358) of canonical collapse pairs, selecting distinct actions (Empathetic Reflection vs Boundary Holding vs Task Execution).
EFE_Action_Valuation.failure_mode: Policy flip near zero boundary if hysteresis/deadband is omitted.
EFE_Action_Valuation.evidence_support: Empirically verified in research adapter (D_pol = 1.0, p = 3.09e-60 on collapse pairs).

Communication_Strategy.rationale: Communicative framing naturally aligns with directional orientation: negative Pleasure error prompts supportiveness, negative Dominance error prompts directness.
Communication_Strategy.failure_mode: Caricatured conversational framing if discrete signs are applied without smoothing.
Communication_Strategy.evidence_support: Strong associations observed in Phase 22 behavioral analysis (r(vP, support) = +0.984, r(vD, direct) = +0.977).

Prompt_Conditioning.rationale: Can inject non-affective framing instructions (e.g., 'User expressing unexpected boundary resistance; adopt measured collaborative tone'). Must strictly enforce BoundaryLayer invariants: NO self-reported affect.
Prompt_Conditioning.failure_mode: Prompt leak violating Pre-Reflective Invariant (e.g. SLM generating 'I feel surprised by your negative valence').
Prompt_Conditioning.evidence_support: Supported in research adapter prompt assembly, but SLM response text unverified.

Response_Synthesis_SLM.rationale: Phase 22 studies evaluated policy selection in an isolated algorithmic adapter; end-to-end token generation quality on local SLMs (Qwen 2.5 / Llama 3.2) was not tested.
Response_Synthesis_SLM.failure_mode: SLM ignores qualitative prompt preambles or exhibits sycophancy regardless of directional conditioning.
Response_Synthesis_SLM.evidence_support: None in Phase 22 (strictly scoped to research adapter).

Affective_Expression_Multimodal.rationale: Whether discrete ternary signs provide sufficiently smooth visual transitions for 3D/Live2D blendshapes or whether continuous R2 is required remains unstudied.
Affective_Expression_Multimodal.failure_mode: Visual micro-expression 'snapping' or discontinuous avatar facial twitching upon discrete sign transitions.

Future_Embodiment.subsystem: Mascot window movement and audio prosody synthesis
Future_Embodiment.rationale: Prosodic pitch/tempo modulation and spatial window gestures have not been conditioned on prediction error side-channels.
Future_Embodiment.failure_mode: Incoherent prosodic cadence or jarring mascot movements.

established_in_research_adapter: Downstream policy arbitration differentiation on 79.89% of collapse pairs.
Monotonic association of scalar S preserved bit-exact (r >= 0.806).
Shuffle control dependency (directional differentiation destroyed under permutation).
untested_and_unproven_for_slm: End-to-end Local Small Language Model response generation quality.
Lexical diversity, conversational nuance, and empathetic coherence in free-form text.
Avoidance of conversational boundary violations under directional prompting.
Continuous multimodal avatar and prosodic expression.
Runtime latency impact under production turn concurrency.
rq6_behavioral_adapter_boundary.boundary_principle: Research Adapter Evidence != End-to-End Layer 6 SLM Evidence. The behavioral sufficiency demonstrated in Phase 22 applies strictly to policy arbitration under the research adapter.

empirical_limitation.T_12_plus: 0 collapse pairs persist (complete resolution for T in {12, 16, 25})

Policy_1_Unconditional_Exposure.title: Always expose R3 regardless of exposure ticks T
Policy_1_Unconditional_Exposure.cons: Downstream consumers receive coarse signs that fail to resolve 66-968 collapses at short conversational exposures.

Policy_2_Gated_Exposure.title: Expose R3 only when T >= 12; output neutral (0, 0, 0) at T < 12
Policy_2_Gated_Exposure.pros: Guarantees 100% collapse resolution whenever direction is active.
Policy_2_Gated_Exposure.cons: Creates a hard step-function discontinuity at T=12 ticks (1.20s).

Policy_3_Exposure_Annotated.title: Always expose R3 alongside explicit metadata 'exposure_ticks: int'
Policy_3_Exposure_Annotated.pros: Downstream consumers can apply confidence weighting based on integration depth; preserves transparency.
Policy_3_Exposure_Annotated.cons: Requires downstream consumers to inspect metadata.

Policy_4_R2_Extension_Path.title: Retain future migration path to continuous R2 for sub-second exposures
Policy_4_R2_Extension_Path.pros: Continuous unit direction R2 resolves 100% of collapses at all T in [1, 25].
Policy_4_R2_Extension_Path.cons: Requires 4 stored floats rather than discrete signs.

rq8_zero_sign_jitter_semantics.problem_formulation: When residual component r_i is near zero (|r_i| < epsilon), infinitesimal floating-point noise or ODE integration perturbations could cause sign fluttering (+1 <-> -1).

proposed_deadband_model.formula: sign_deadband(x, eps) = +1 if x > eps else (-1 if x < -eps else 0)

hysteresis_option.description: Retain prior turn sign if |r_i| < epsilon_hysteresis to prevent turn-to-turn sign oscillation.

rq8_zero_sign_jitter_semantics.validation_experiment_required: A parametric noise sensitivity sweep across epsilon in [0.001, 0.050] on stimulus set G1 to determine the optimal deadband threshold that suppresses jitter while preserving legitimate small transitions.

rq9_future_r2_compatibility.mathematical_property: R3 is derivable from R2 through a deterministic sign projection of the directional components, provided the R2 contract preserves component orientation: sign(v_hat_i) == sign(r_i) for all ||r|| > 0.

interface_evolution_strategy.future_r2_phase: Interface adds optional .direction_unit (Tuple[float, float, float]). Consumers expecting .direction_signs continue to receive the deterministic sign projection with ZERO breaking changes.
interface_evolution_strategy.backward_compatibility: Guaranteed. S remains invariant, and R3 remains available as a projected property of R2.

bodily_displacement.semantics: Raw somatic excursion from resting attractor Philia (+0.25, -0.05, +0.05). Reflects physical bodily state.
bodily_displacement.adaptation_behavior: Fixed origin; does not adapt to predictive context.

prediction_residual.formula: r_T = p_hat_T - p_T = (A * p_{T-1} + b) - p_T
prediction_residual.semantics: Cognitive prediction error: difference between internal generative expectation and actual bodily feedback.
prediction_residual.adaptation_behavior: Dynamic origin; belief matrices A and b adapt online via gradient descent.

rq10_residual_vs_displacement.empirical_divergence: In the Phase 22 Measurement Study, under online adaptation at T=12, r_T diverged from -Delta_p by 179.5 degrees. Equating prediction error with raw bodily displacement is mathematically invalid once beliefs adapt.
rq10_residual_vs_displacement.architectural_invariant: R3 must be derived strictly from prediction residual r_T = p_hat_T - p_T, NEVER from bodily displacement Delta_p.

claims_and_evidence.claim: Scalar surprise S = ||r_T||_2 represents prediction-error magnitude.
claims_and_evidence.justification: Directly matches L2 Euclidean norm of sensory prediction error in Active Inference.

claims_and_evidence.claim: Free Energy metric correspondence under the adopted quadratic residual formulation: F proportional to 1/2 S^2.
claims_and_evidence.justification: Under isotropic precision Pi = I, variational free energy bound F = 1/2 r^T r = 1/2 S^2. This is a consequence under the specific quadratic residual formulation, NOT a universal identity of all Free Energy formulations.

claims_and_evidence.claim: Gradient descent driving belief updates dFE/dp proportional to -r.
claims_and_evidence.justification: Analytic consequence under quadratic prediction error residual; not a general claim for unconstrained Active Inference systems.

claims_and_evidence.claim: Directional sign R3 = sign(r) modulates Expected Free Energy (EFE) qualitative action selection.
claims_and_evidence.justification: Phase 22 Behavioral study demonstrated distinct action selection corresponding to directional orientation, consistent with EFE modulation.

claims_and_evidence.claim: Dynamic precision weighting Pi(t) enhances directional measurement.
claims_and_evidence.justification: Fixed precision candidates failed Gate 2; dynamic precision models remain unvalidated hypotheses.

rq12_adr_readiness.operational_meaning: The accumulated Phase 22 H1 research evidence is sufficient to author a formal RESEARCH DRAFT Architectural Decision Record (DRAFT ADR-029). CRITICAL: Being 'READY FOR ADR DRAFT' does NOT imply Architecture Gate approval. The Production Architecture Gate remains STRICTLY LOCKED. Any prepared ADR remains DRAFT / NOT RATIFIED / NOT IMPLEMENTED until formal Gate 2 resolution and explicit governance sign-off.

architecture_invariants.name: Scalar Preservation Invariant
architecture_invariants.statement: S_new = ||r_T||_2 is algebraically and computationally identical to S_canonical. No directional representation may scale, compress, or modify S.

architecture_invariants.name: Directional Derivation Invariant
architecture_invariants.statement: R3 = sign(r_T) must be derived from the exact same prediction residual vector r_T from which S is derived.

architecture_invariants.name: No Feedback Into S Invariant
architecture_invariants.statement: Directional side-channels must never feed back into scalar surprise computation or Active Inference learning rates.

architecture_invariants.name: No Implicit ODE Mutation Invariant
architecture_invariants.statement: Directional prediction error must never be injected into the Coupled MT-LNN ODE hidden state h(t) or alter baseline resting attractor Philia.

architecture_invariants.name: Genesis Gate Isolation Invariant
architecture_invariants.statement: data/profile.json must remain bit-exact {'is_onboarded': false}. Research feasibility exploration never alters onboarding state.

architecture_invariants.name: Historical Immutability Invariant
architecture_invariants.statement: Historical benchmark archives (v1.4, calibration, headroom, gate2, measurement) remain cryptographically immutable.

architecture_invariants.name: Production Isolation Invariant
architecture_invariants.statement: Feasibility verification within tests/evaluation_phase22/ does not authorize changes to src/core/** or production deployment.

architecture_invariants.name: Value Object Immutability Invariant
architecture_invariants.statement: The measurement representation (PhysiologicalSurprise) must be a frozen, immutable value object with no public mutating methods.

architecture_invariants.name: Fallback Identity Invariant
architecture_invariants.statement: Neutralizing directional components (direction = (0, 0, 0)) must produce generation behavior bit-exact identical to canonical scalar S baseline (Condition C0).

failure_modes.title: Sign Jitter Near Zero Boundary
failure_modes.evidence: Infinitesimal floating-point perturbations when |r_i| < 1e-4 can flip sign between +1 and -1.
failure_modes.severity: Moderate (causes communicative strategy fluttering near boundary).
failure_modes.validation_required: Parametric deadband noise sweep on Candidate G1.

failure_modes.title: Zero-Crossing Instability During Oscillations
failure_modes.evidence: Rapid turn-to-turn transitions crossing zero can cause rapid policy switching.
failure_modes.mitigation: Turn-to-turn sign hysteresis or exponential smoothing in communication state.

failure_modes.title: Short-Timescale Collapse Persisting (T < 12)
failure_modes.evidence: R3 retains 66 to 968 collapse pairs at T in {1, 2, 4, 8}.
failure_modes.severity: High for sub-second rapid dialogue; Low for conversational pacing (T >= 12).
failure_modes.mitigation: Attach exposure metadata (Policy 3) or provide continuous R2 extension path (Option E).
failure_modes.validation_required: Conversational turn-latency profiling in human interaction.

failure_modes.title: Adapter-Specific Prior Inductive Bias
failure_modes.evidence: Research adapter used piecewise linear EFE terms naturally aligned with octant signs.
failure_modes.mitigation: Test across varied policy arbitration formulations (e.g. non-linear softmax).

failure_modes.title: Semantic Coupling Leak into Scalar S
failure_modes.evidence: Risk that future developer scales S by directional components.
failure_modes.severity: Critical (would break canonical Active Inference surprise).
failure_modes.mitigation: Hard assertion INV-1 in value object constructor: S is strictly independent.
failure_modes.validation_required: Automated regression tests verifying S_new == S_canonical.

failure_modes.title: Future R2 Migration Breaking Changes
failure_modes.evidence: If interface hardcodes ternary tuple, adding continuous angles would break consumers.
failure_modes.mitigation: Option E Abstract Measurement Interface with .direction_signs derived from R2 if R2 is active.

failure_modes.title: Continuous Embodiment Visual Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Discrete signs could cause facial blendshape snapping on 3D/Live2D avatar.
failure_modes.mitigation: ExpressionPolicy applies temporal low-pass filtering to blendshape actuation.

failure_modes.title: SLM Prompt Interpretation Unknowns
failure_modes.evidence: Local SLM (Layer 6) has not been evaluated for qualitative directional preamble adherence.
failure_modes.mitigation: BoundaryLayer regex enforcement preventing self-reported affect; prompt calibration.
failure_modes.validation_required: Isolated SLM generation benchmark on local hardware.

failure_modes.title: Offline Tier 3 Consolidation Interference
failure_modes.evidence: Persisting discrete signs into continuous synaptic tensors could destabilize BPTT.
failure_modes.mitigation: Tier 3 BPTT continues to train strictly on continuous ODE trajectories; R3 is excluded from weight loss.
failure_modes.validation_required: Offline consolidation stability evaluation over 100 training epochs.

failure_modes.title: Serialization and State Schema Breakage
failure_modes.evidence: Adding fields to CognitiveTurnResult could break GET /state telemetry serialization.
failure_modes.mitigation: Additive optional fields with backward-compatible defaults; float coercion.

failure_modes.title: Downstream Overuse / Over-Reliance on Coarse Signs
failure_modes.evidence: Developers might treat 27 discrete states as a full emotion taxonomy.
failure_modes.mitigation: Explicit architectural prohibition: R3 is prediction error direction, NOT an emotional label.
failure_modes.validation_required: Linting guards and code review invariant enforcement.

failure_modes.title: Accidental Substitution of S by R3
failure_modes.evidence: A downstream component might check sign instead of scalar intensity for urgency.
failure_modes.mitigation: Somatic markers (load, tension) must refuse directional inputs by type checking.
failure_modes.validation_required: Strict type hints and runtime type validation.
